name: duckdb_describe_table
description:
Column definitions and row count of one DuckDB table, optionally with sample rows. Each CSV, TSV, Parquet and JSON file in the DuckDB data folder (data.duckdb.dir, default data/duckdb) is a table named after the file (orders.csv is orders), in an in-memory sandbox with no file or URL access; changed files are reloaded automatically.
Returns {table_name, table_type, columns, row_count, sample_data (when asked)}: each column is {column_name, data_type, nullable, is_primary_key, default_value when set}.
Inputs (* required): table_name* (case-insensitive), include_sample_data (default false), sample_size (1-100; default 5).
For value distributions use duckdb_get_stats; to query duckdb_query.
Example: {"table_name": "orders", "include_sample_data": true, "sample_size": 3}

table_name.description: Name of table or view to describe

include_sample_data.description: Include sample rows from the table

sample_size.description: Number of sample rows to return (if include_sample_data is true)

data_type.description: DuckDB data type (e.g., INTEGER, VARCHAR, DOUBLE)

default_value.description: Default value for the column (if any)

is_primary_key.description: Whether column is part of primary key

row_count.description: Total number of rows in the table

sample_data.description: Sample rows from the table (if requested)

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Provides detailed schema information for tables and views
